text:
The diff does not cleanly enable jumbo frames end to end. leaf4's first interface and spine1's matching interface (10.0.2.25/30 and 10.0.2.26/30) are set to MTU 1400, which is a reduction. This breaks even standard 1500-byte traffic over that link, and the link may go down for OSPF because of the MTU mismatch with neighbors. The leaf4-spine2 link is set to 9000 on both sides, and the leaf6-spine1 and leaf6-spine2 links are 9000 on both sides. So the jumbo path via spine2 may work, but the 1400 link must be checked for regressions, and non-affected traffic must be confirmed unchanged.

I'm assuming the 10.0.2.25/26 link is leaf4-spine1, 10.0.2.29/30 is leaf4-spine2, 10.0.2.41/42 is leaf6-spine1, and 10.0.2.45/46 is leaf6-spine2, as the diff implies. I'm assuming web-b1 attaches to leaf4 and backup1 to leaf6, consistent with the ticket.
